channel.title: Taumata 3001
channel.desc: NEW: From an imagined point one thousnad years into the future, we give a sliver of our most recent history the perspective of distance. We consider the 21 years after the 1984 Hui Taumata when a resurgent M?ori people confronted their oppression and survived it.

channel.name: Whakaata Maori NZ
channel.title: Being Turi - Deaf M?ori
channel.desc: NEW: "Being Turi-Deaf M?ori," offers an unprecedented opportunity to shed light on the often-overlooked challenges faced by the Turi-Deaf M?ori community. With limited access to their own cultural heritage due to communication barriers, this community has strived to bridge the gap between their unique identity and their rightful place within Te Ao M?ori.
